day_shape: US and allies mark one-year anniversary of UN snapback with joint statement, Treasury sanctions France-based Hamas crypto-funding network, IDF strike in Gaza City targeted Sinwar successor Ali al-Amoudi, tanker struck exiting Strait of Hormuz, two Iranians charged in UK over Manchester Jewish-community plot.

threads.label: Snapback anniversary and WMD pledge
threads.summary: The US State Department released a joint statement with dozens of allies marking the anniversary of UN snapback restrictions on Iran. Signatories pledged to step up efforts to prevent Iranian WMD development, per Jerusalem Post coverage.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Hamas targeting
threads.summary: The IDF said an overnight airstrike in western Gaza City targeted Ali al-Amoudi, described as Yahya Sinwar's successor as Hamas's Gaza leader, with Palestinian media reporting five killed. A separate IDF-ISA strike in Khan Younis killed Hamas sniper Tamer Hamaida.

threads.label: US posture on Iran and Yemen
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump attended a secret Camp David meeting on Iran and Yemen chaired by VP Vance, and that the US military is planning to add thousands of naval forces including up to three carriers. Defa Press claimed America dispatched seven new warships with 9,000 personnel to West Asia.

threads.label: Hamas financing sanctions and Jordan call
threads.summary: The US Treasury designated a Hamas military operative in Gaza and a France-based fundraising network that used sham charities and cryptocurrency to raise nearly $2 million. Secretary Rubio also spoke with Jordan's King Abdullah II on Lebanon's Trilateral Framework and disarming Hezbollah.

threads.label: Iran economy in freefall
threads.summary: Iran International reported the euro crossed 3 million rials for the first time and the dollar neared 2.7 million on the open market, with the stock index hitting records as households flee the currency. Officials traded blame over the crisis.

threads.label: Iran internal repression and dissent
threads.summary: Iran executed Siavash Jamshidi Kheirabadi, arrested during January's Shahrekord protests, per the judiciary's Mizan agency; Defa Press framed him as an "armed thug". An appeals court upheld a one-year sentence against actress Elnaz Shakerdoost, and the Intelligence Ministry claimed 31 arrests across four "sabotage networks" in Sirjan.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Iran-linked UK plot
threads.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker was struck exiting the Strait of Hormuz, and IRIB claimed Iran's seized Tousca medicine ship will be pursued in international courts. UK police charged two Iranian men over a disrupted plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community on the eve of Yom Kippur.

events.title: An Israeli airstrike in Gaza City overnight targeted senior Hamas official Ali al-Amoudi, according to a security source, with Palestinian media reporting five people killed. The strike hit a building in western Gaza City. Palestinian media reported that those killed included a young man, a mother and her daughter, and two other adult women. Amoudi was not named among the dead. The IDF has not yet commented on the strike as it assesses the results. Amoudi has been reported to be a frontrunner to succeed Khalil al-Hayya as head of Hamas’s political bureau in the Gaza Strip. He is currently believed to be the de facto senior-most Hamas political official in the Strip.
